blocks.html: OPM Pop Princess, Janella Salvador perform at Robinsons Novaliches, Trade Hall for her Album Tour on May 15, 2016 at 5 P.M. Janella will be performing tracks from her self-titled album which features nine (9) pop and inspirational tracks with her hit single “Ganyan Talaga” her versions of Sharon Cuneta’s “Dear Heart” and Donna Cruz’s “I Can”. A worthy thespian, Janella was recently o chosen by Hong Kong Disneyland to be the Philippines’ Representative to sing their 10th anniversary themed song “Happily Ever After” and was one of the top 15 finalists in 2016 Himig Handog P-Pop Song. “Meet and greet” session follows after her performance.
